title: BYOP consent screens identify apps more reliably
summary:
BYOP consent screens stopped guessing app identities, API-key creation got tighter validation, and the app showcase got its credits right.

App identity now comes from a client ID or app key, not a match against a registered URL. Without an app key, the consent screen shows the redirect hostname rather than guessing which app is asking.

Key creation now checks permissions and metadata before creating the key, replacing the dashboard's create-then-update flow. System-managed key metadata remains outside user edits.

An automated catalog refresh updated app metrics, followed by README attribution corrections. Recent Apps now credits TimeMachine Chat to @timemachine-studio, Scene2Text to @tatn, and AI Models Laboratory to @OSK0020.
